title: Nocturne Bedspread Pattern #6105
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #186 Bedspreads to Knit and Crochet (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Ch 7, join with sl st." replaced by magic ring. Only the First Motif (rounds 1-7) kept; second-motif joining and spread edging omitted. In R6/R7 the pattern works only part of each tr group (e.g. 'skip 1 tr, tr in next 5 tr' over 9-tr groups); the DSL marks the leftover tr as skipped. Stitch graph: round 6 reads badly (cost 11.5); check where its stitches go.
